faults.title: Failing ignition coils (Mk4)
faults.description: On the 2012-2019 Mk4, ignition coils can fail and cause poor running. Auto Express puts a replacement coil at around £40 plus fitting.

faults.title: Weak tyre pressure and ABS sensors (Mk4)
faults.description: Mk4 tyre pressure sensors aren't very robust and have to be replaced if they fail. ABS sensors can fail too, shown by a warning light.

faults.title: Mk4 recalls: brake hoses, wheels
faults.description: The Mk4 had eight recalls, including front brake hoses chafing on the wheelarch liner, fuel leaks, wheels coming loose, a detaching rear spoiler and rear seat hinges that could fail in a crash.

faults.title: E-Tech hybrid needing roadside resets (Mk5)
faults.description: Auto Express knows of no major issues on the 2019-on Mk5, but has heard of some E-Tech hybrids needing a roadside reset by a breakdown service.

faults.title: Steering column recall (Mk5)
faults.description: 72 early Mk5s built June to October 2019 were recalled in February 2020 because the electric power steering assistance could fail. A new steering column was fitted.
